architecturalPlan.scaleRationale: Offline composition revision: retain the ground-floor residence and add a recessed 64 m² upper west suite. Budget adequacy and full programme remain unproven.
architecturalPlan.arrivalAndCirculation: Arrival is assumed from the landward south side. A limestone approach court leads to a recessed bronze front door beneath a dedicated canopy. The entrance opens directly into the tall central living salon, with bedroom wings branching west and east. The oceanward axis continues through broad glazed openings to a shaded terrace, pool court and a detached open elliptical ocean lounge pavilion.
architecturalPlan.volumeHierarchy: Two-storey recessed west anchor, intermediate tall salon, low east wing and shaded sea veranda. Distinct heights and setbacks replace equal lateral bars.
architecturalPlan.relationshipsAndViews: The central salon is oriented toward the assumed ocean outlook to the north, with three separate framed glazed bays rather than an indiscriminate glass curtain. Its terrace is immediately beyond, shaded by a deep flat canopy and structured by timber posts. The lateral wings retain comparatively solid, private external edges while their inner walls connect back to the central living volume. The pool court and pavilion extend the same central axis without claiming a surveyed shoreline.
architecturalPlan.roofFacadeAndMaterials: Coordinated stepped flat roofs; west lower roof becomes terrace slab. Upper suite has its own smaller cap.
intendedSpaces: Covered landward arrival court and recessed entrance threshold
Double-height central living and entertaining salon
East private bedroom-suite and flexible service wing
